description: Deletes a draft, scheduled or recurring notification, cancelling it if it had not gone out yet. A notification that has already been sent CANNOT be deleted — its delivery record is kept — and neither can an RSS auto-push notification. Deleting the PARENT of an A/B test removes the whole test including its other variant; a single variant cannot be deleted on its own, and neither can a drip, triggered or single-timezone notification. For a subscriber-timezone send this also removes the per timezone notifications that have not been delivered. This cancels a pending send, so confirm with the user before calling it.

notification_id.description: The notification to act on. Get it from pushengage_list_notifications, or from the notification_id a send tool returned.

name: pushengage_delete_notification
title: Delete a notification
